ATLAS-side edit not in formal-math: VariableChangePoint.lean gains `VariableChange.nonsingular_mapAffineCoordinates_iff`, the additive equivalence `WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Point.variableChangeAddEquiv`, built on `affineCoordinatesEquiv` and `nonsingularPointEquiv` with the addition proof adapted from anthropics/fermats-last-theorem, and `variableChangeAddEquiv_toEquiv`, which identifies its underlying equivalence with `VariableChange.pointEquiv` for elliptic curves; its test file gains concrete examples over ZMod 5 and the rationals. The production file keeps its docstring restatement from the Atlas wiki audit (#265).
